Permission at tomorrow’s 09:00 sitting would also not retroactively cover a change made today.

Why: the irreversibility of destruction is exactly why the extension control exists, but the control puts the decision with the duty manager in writing before the date changes. The EUR 22 rework charge, the quarterly target, and the collection booking do not give the desk operator discretion to override that rule. If released on schedule, the box would be collected at 14:30 and destroyed the same day; the compliant desk action today is therefore on-time release, not a self-granted extension.
